original: 彼女は一見正直そうに見える。

en.text: She is apparently an honest woman.

indices: 彼女[01] は 一見(いっけん)[02] 正直[01] 然う[01]{そう} に 見える(みえる)

original: この問題は一見簡単そうだが実は難しい。

en.text: This problem seems to be easy on the surface, but it's really difficult.

indices: 此の{この} 問題 は 一見(いっけん)[02]~ 簡単 そう[01] だ が[03] 実は 難しい

en.text: His statement sounds correct at first, but upon thinking carefully, you realize it's contradictory.
